label: Primordial Chaos
notes: State of undifferentiated void, waters, or darkness before creation

label: Cosmic Egg
notes: Universe or primordial being(s) born from a cosmic egg

label: Creation by Deity
notes: A single or multiple creator god(s) actively fashion(s) the world and/or life

label: Emergence Creation
notes: Humanity/life emerges from beneath the earth or a lower world

label: Earth-Diver Creation
notes: A being (often animal) dives into primordial waters to bring up mud for creating land

label: World Parent Separation
notes: Creation from the separation of primordial Sky Father and Earth Mother

label: Dismemberment Creation
notes: World or aspects of it formed from the body of a sacrificed/slain primordial being

label: Theomachy/War of Gods
notes: Conflict between generations of gods or divine factions (e.g., Titanomachy, Aesir-Vanir War)

label: Age of Gods
notes: Mythical era when deities dwelled on earth or interacted frequently with mortals

label: Age of Heroes
notes: Mythical era characterized by the deeds of semi-divine or exceptional mortal heroes

label: Global Flood Episode
notes: Narrative segment detailing a cataclysmic flood that purges or reshapes the world

label: Trickster Exploits
notes: Specific deeds of a trickster figure, often involving deception, transformation, and cultural invention

label: Theft of Fire Episode
notes: Narrative of a hero or trickster stealing fire for humanity from gods or a guarded source

label: Heroic Quest Episode
notes: Segment detailing a hero's journey to obtain a specific object, knowledge, or achieve a set goal

label: Descent to Underworld
notes: Hero or deity journeys to the land of the dead

label: Death & Rebirth of Figure
notes: A god, hero, or nature spirit undergoes death and subsequent resurrection/renewal

label: Monster Slaying
notes: Hero confronts and defeats a significant monstrous antagonist

label: Foundation of City/Ritual
notes: Narrative of the establishment of a significant place, custom, or ritual

label: Culture Hero's Teachings
notes: Episode where a culture hero imparts knowledge, laws, arts, or skills to humanity

label: Shapeshifting Event
notes: Significant instance of a character transforming their physical form

label: Otherworldly Journey
notes: Travel to a supernatural realm (not necessarily underworld, e.g., celestial, fairy realm)

label: Loss of Paradise/Expulsion
notes: Narrative detailing a fall from an idyllic state or expulsion from a sacred land

label: Apocalypse and Renewal
notes: Episode describing the destruction of the current world order and its subsequent rebirth or transformation

label: Divine Conception/Birth
notes: Miraculous or unusual birth of a hero or god

label: Oracular Pronouncement
notes: A prophecy or divine message is delivered, often shaping future events
